transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Touring Show Producer. As we get started, I want to make sure we're all on the same page about Saturday's one-night performance at Harbor Arena. I need to approve the final load-in plan before any trucking instructions or crew calls go out, and part of my process is a final check-in with venue technical management and production management. So let's talk through where we stand with the current draft plan.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue with the current draft plan. I received the arena's certified access measurements from facilities this morning: the dock door is 2.4 meters wide, but the single-piece scenic arch crate is 2.6 meters wide. The arch won't fit through the dock door as a single piece — it'll need to be transported as a sectional arch and brought through the ground-level dock. The certificate arrived after the draft plan was circulated, so I haven't added it to the production file yet, but this changes the load-in plan significantly.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to share something important I confirmed this afternoon with the arena labor steward. The labor agreement requires exactly six arena stagehands, with a call from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and it prohibits the touring crew from self-unloading the trucks. I haven't logged this confirmation yet because the steward returned it after our daily production meeting. This is critical for the load-in plan, especially given Dev's point about needing to use the ground-level dock — we'll need those six stagehands to handle all unloading, and the 7 AM to 1 PM call window needs to be factored into the revised schedule.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both — Dev and Leila, these are exactly the kinds of issues I need resolved before I can approve the final load-in plan. So to summarize what's changed from the current draft: First, the scenic arch can't come through the dock door as a single piece — it needs to be broken down into a sectional configuration and brought through the ground-level dock. Second, the labor agreement requires exactly six arena stagehands on a 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM call, and the touring crew cannot self-unload. Both of these materially change the draft plan. Before I can lock this down and issue trucking instructions and crew calls, I need to do my final check-in with venue technical management and production management to confirm the ground-level dock access and the labor call window are aligned. Are there any other issues anyone is aware of that would affect the revised plan?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: No other issues on my end. I'll get the certified access measurements added to the production file right away so everything's documented for your final check-in. I'm ready to confirm ground-level dock access for the sectional arch whenever you need it.
